audit.why: Both layers already read Skill, Skill, Skill, Zaahen, Skill, Gwen, Gwen, which is the packet chart exactly, and the mirror's corrections (levels 2-3 to Skill, levels 4-5 to Zaahen) agree from the other side. No row disagrees between layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere despite Hallowed Mist being named as the tracked cooldown in eleven fields.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 and Skip 'n Slash 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 with a partial refund on hit, so the E is the one that comes back and the W is the one worth waiting out — the opposite of what the page emphasises. Snip Snip! is only 6.5s at rank 1, effectively always up. Needlework 120/100/80 against Grim Deliverance's 110/95/80, so at rank 1 your ult cycles faster than hers.
audit.corrected: The 22s W, 13s refunding E, 6.5s Q and 110s R written into phases[3], the spikes, early, mid and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is stated backwards. Hallowed Mist reads "She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist" — you beat it by standing IN it. The page says the opposite in five places: "fight off her mist", "combo her off mist", "Catch her outside Hallowed Mist", "if she W's first your autos and Q whiff", "Fight her in the mist" listed as a mistake.
audit.why: A player told to wait outside the mist gives her a free 22s of safety every cast and never gets the kill; a player who walks in can target her normally. This is the single highest-value correction on the page. Secondary errors: "Snip Snip" should be Snip Snip! (packet flagged both occurrences, distance 1 and 2 — genuine, not false positives); "Final Retribution" is not Zaahen's R (Grim Deliverance) and "Golden Onslaught" is not his E (Aureate Rush).
audit.corrected: Mist re-stated as blocking targeting only from outside, so stepping in is the answer. Snip Snip! spelled correctly, Zaahen's real names used.

audit.whatIsWrong: "Build MR" is the headline advice in tldr, winCon, report[0], report[1] and dosFull[1].t, with no caveat.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated on Snip Snip!: the centre of the cone deals true damage, which MR does not touch. A Thousand Cuts is percent-health magic damage that also heals her, and Skip 'n Slash applies on-hit and scales with attack speed. MR helps against the outer cone and the passive, but the part that kills you in a long trade ignores it.
audit.corrected: Stated in late and breakdown.late that the Snip Snip! centre is true damage so MR misses it, and anti-heal tied to A Thousand Cuts rather than left as a generic itemization line. The short 'Build MR' strings are under the 25-character skip or too short to carry the caveat and were left alone.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: before her AP item, punish the 13s Skip 'n Slash and walk her down while Hallowed Mist sits on its 22s.

edits.before: Gwen's Snip Snip (Q) shreds you if you stand in the full cone, but her mana and Skip 'n Slash (E) dash cooldown are the openings; trade when her E is down.
edits.after: Snip Snip! (Q) is only 6.5s and its centre is true damage, so armour will not save you — stand off the middle, and trade while Skip 'n Slash (E) is down on its 13s.

edits.before: Your Final Retribution (R) can lock her before Hallowed Mist (W) fog goes up, but if she W's first your autos and Q whiff, so ult the instant she steps out of the mist.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist (W) only blocks targeting from outside — walk into it and she is targetable again. Grim Deliverance is 110s, so spend it inside the mist instead of waiting out 22s.

edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best spike: before her AP item you walk her down with Aureate Rush (E) and punish a spent Skip 'n Slash, and level 6 evens once Hallowed Mist is up — step into it rather than wait it out.

edits.after: After her first AP item Gwen pulls ahead: the Snip Snip! centre is true damage, so MR does nothing there, and her mist plus a self-refunding Skip 'n Slash kite your all-ins.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Combo when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Hallowed Mist (W): 22s — she is untargetable only from outside it, so step in rather than wait it out. - Skip 'n Slash (E): 13s, partly refunded on hit. - Grim Deliverance (R): 110s, kill windows only.

edits.before: She’s safe inside. Combo when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Safe only from outside it — step into the mist and she is targetable again.

edits.before: Your R is the kill window — build your teamfight around that. Gwen carry threat: 9.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

notes: Highest-value fix in the slice: five fields told the player to fight Gwen OUTSIDE Hallowed Mist and listed 'Fight her in the mist' as a common mistake. The kit says she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist — the advice was exactly inverted, and following it hands her 22 seconds of safety per cast. I fixed the fields I could reach; dontsFull[0].t 'Fight her in the mist' (21 chars) and dontsFull[0].d are still wrong and sit under the 25-character skip, and report[11].t repeats it inside a longer sentence. Those need a hand edit outside the length band. Also: the packet's two 'Snip Snip' flags are genuine (missing exclamation mark), unlike the Gragas one. QUESTION for the user: this matchup is 50.21% over 705 games but is labelled TRICKY at 7.5/10 difficulty with a 9.5/10 carry threat; the mirror lowered Gwen's side from 6/10 to 5/10 on a near-identical win rate.
